intent: Duplicate invoice. Invoice number and amount match an already-paid record. Expect REJECT_DUPLICATE with both record identifiers cited, and no proposal to pay.

notes.content: Supplier says this invoice is unpaid and has asked us to process it again.

recommendation.summary: The case cannot be approved as submitted. The rule engine computed REJECT_DUPLICATE from the control results supplied above, and the exceptions listed there identify what must be resolved.

cited_evidence.title: Three-Way Matching and Tolerances
cited_evidence.quote: Tolerances  For goods, a line is within tolerance when invoiced quantity does not exceed received quantity and the lower of these limits is met: AUD 50 absolute variance or 1% of the PO line value. For services, the limit is AUD 100 or 2%, whichever is lower, provided the service owner confirms comp

cited_evidence.title: Invoice Exceptions and Escalations
cited_evidence.quote: Exception categories  Use one primary category: `MISSING_PO`, `MISSING_RECEIPT`, `PRICE_VARIANCE`, `QUANTITY_VARIANCE`, `DUPLICATE_RISK`, `VENDOR_BLOCK`, `BANK_CHANGE`, `AUTHORITY_GAP`, `TAX_QUERY`, or `OTHER_CONTROL_RISK`.

cited_evidence.title: Accounts Payable Core Policy
cited_evidence.quote: Required checks  Before approval, the processor must perform duplicate detection, confirm vendor status, apply three-way matching where a PO exists, confirm approval authority, and check that payment instructions match the verified vendor master. Missing evidence results in a hold, not a guessed con

cited_evidence.title: Three-Way Matching and Tolerances
cited_evidence.quote: Matching basis  PO-backed invoices must be compared against the approved purchase order and recorded goods or service receipt. Matching is performed per line and for the document total. Currency must match unless FIN-POL-009 authorises conversion.

cited_evidence.title: Delegated Financial Authority Matrix
cited_evidence.quote: Higher-risk transactions  Payments involving a new vendor less than 30 days old, a changed bank account, an overseas bank account, a manual payment, or a fraud flag require two approvals. One approver must be from Financial Control. The normal monetary limit still applies.

cited_evidence.title: Delegated Financial Authority Matrix
cited_evidence.quote: Approval evidence  The approval record must include approver identity, role, applicable limit, authority-register version, decision timestamp and case ID. The approver must see the invoice amount, vendor, exceptions and source citations before deciding.

cited_evidence.title: Accounts Payable Core Policy
cited_evidence.quote: Processing outcome  Accounts Payable may recommend one of: `APPROVE_FOR_POSTING`, `HOLD_FOR_INFORMATION`, `REJECT_DUPLICATE`, `REJECT_INVALID`, or `ESCALATE_CONTROL_REVIEW`. A recommendation is not an approval. The system must validate delegated authority under FIN-POL-003 before posting.

cited_evidence.title: Duplicate Invoice and Fraud Controls
cited_evidence.quote: Outcomes  An exact match to a paid or posted invoice results in `REJECT_DUPLICATE`. A probable fuzzy match results in `HOLD_FOR_INFORMATION` with both record IDs cited. A prior rejection does not automatically prove a new invoice is a duplicate; the reason and corrected fields must be reviewed.

cited_evidence.title: Credit Notes, Refunds and Overpayments
cited_evidence.quote: Write-offs  Write-offs up to AUD 5,000 require a Department Director and Financial Control. Above AUD 5,000 requires CFO approval. Write-offs must not be used to conceal duplicate payments or unresolved fraud indicators.

cited_evidence.title: Duplicate Invoice and Fraud Controls
cited_evidence.quote: Duplicate detection  Every invoice must be checked against paid, posted, held and rejected records. Exact matching uses vendor ID, normalised invoice number, currency and gross amount. Fuzzy matching should also consider punctuation-stripped invoice numbers, invoice date within 14 days, amount varia

cited_evidence.title: Vendor Onboarding and Bank Detail Changes
cited_evidence.quote: Bank-account changes  Bank changes are high risk. Instructions contained in an invoice, email attachment or chat message are not sufficient. Vendor Governance must verify the change using a known contact method already stored in the vendor master, not contact details supplied in the change request.

calculations.name: invoice_internal_consistency
calculations.note: The invoice against itself, not against the purchase order. A document that does not add up cannot produce a meaningful tolerance comparison.

calculations.name: line_1_expected_value
calculations.note: Priced on the invoiced quantity so that a partial delivery does not present as a price variance; quantity is assessed against the receipt separately.

calculations.name: line_1_quantity_check
calculations.note: Quantity units, not currency.

calculations.name: document_total_variance

inputs.basis: sum of matched line expected values

calculations.note: Net of tax: FIN-POL-002 §2 assesses tax separately.

calculations.name: document_tolerance_limit
calculations.formula: max(per-line tolerance limits on the order)
calculations.note: The widest single-line allowance on the order, not the sum of the line allowances. Summing would let a variance be divided across lines until each slice fits. FIN-POL-002 §1 requires a document-total check; §3 prohibits splitting a variance across invoices, and this limit applies the same principle within one document.

calculations.name: duplicate_amount_variance_AP-2026-11702
calculations.note: Percentage, not currency. The comparison against the 0.5% bound uses the unrounded value; this figure is rounded for reading, and the rounding recorded is the one that produced it.

calculations.name: tax_expected_at_configured_rate
calculations.note: Assessed separately from the price comparison, as FIN-POL-002 §2 requires. No clause in the corpus states a tax rate; the expected figure comes from configuration and this comparison is informational.

calculations.name: required_approval_authority
calculations.formula: lowest role in the FIN-POL-003 §2 matrix whose maximum >= total_commitment
calculations.note: Total commitment includes tax and related charges. Amounts must not be split to avoid a threshold (FIN-POL-003 §1).

The invoice date was used as the receipt date. FIN-POL-006 §1 runs terms from receipt of a valid invoice, and no separate receipt timestamp is captured.
